warnings: option 43 string used in run 3 was rejected by IOS as an invalid PnP option; it was a probe, not a PnP configuration
status_reason: device-side: this image's AutoInstall handler stops ('Discovery Failed', timeout 0 ms) before any offer is processed, with two independent DHCP servers; InfraFlow cannot change it

diagnosis.expected: AutoInstall: DISCOVER, OFFER, REQUEST, ACK, then TFTP of network-confg/router-confg
diagnosis.observed: DISCOVER/OFFER repeated, no REQUEST; RARP fallback; IOS trace shows the Auto Installer handler starting and stopping in the same millisecond
diagnosis.cause: IOSv 15.9(3)M6 AutoInstall/PnP handler gives up immediately ('PnP autoinstall exceeded timeout (0) ms', 'IP-Resolved: No'); the image's own regular DHCP client accepts the same offers
evidence: pnp-tech-discovery-summary lines 'stopped, reason:[Discovery Failed]' and 'exceeded timeout (0) ms'
manual 'ip address dhcp' binds with the same server
ruled_out: InfraFlow DHCP server defect (reference ISC dhcpd behaves identically)
reply addressing (broadcast OFFER observed on the client link)
startup-config present (hdb detached, setup dialog reached)
diagnosis.next_check: use an image whose AutoInstall works (Cisco 7200 12.4(24)T5 PASS in 2026-11-19 evidence) or physical hardware; IOSv day-0 can only be validated via console or the existing SSH executor
